title: 2023 AMC 12B Problem 19
statement: Each of \(2023\) balls is placed in one of \(3\) bins. Which of the following is closest to the probability that each of the bins will contain an odd number of balls?

solutions.text:
Counting assignments where all three bins are odd with the parity filter gives \[ \scriptsize\frac{1}{8}\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,2,3\}}(-1)^{|S|}(3-2|S|)^n=\frac{3^n-3}{4} \] for odd \(n.\) Dividing by the \(3^n\) total assignments, the probability is \(\dfrac{3^n-3}{4\cdot 3^n},\) which for \(n=2023\) is extremely close to \(\tfrac14.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: Each ball lands independently; use a parity filter, writing bin \(i\) odd as \(\tfrac{1-(-1)^{k_i}}{2}\)
Summing over all assignments, the all-odd fraction is \(\dfrac{3^{\,n}-3}{4\cdot 3^{\,n}};\) see what it approaches for large \(n\)
